notes.title: Version 1.0.2 - Added dedicated Randomizer button
notes.notes:
Hello there,

Just a heads up that the face buttons have been slightly tweaked to allow for a dedicated Randomization button. This button will randomize the percussion, music, and effects (in a more subtle way). It can still focus on favorited kits as well.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970775/21a0fbb15b81d6dc1a40bc905a55c1085d9496ac.png

Thanks,

Larry

notes.title: Taiko 5 updated to version 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello there!

Taiko 5 has been updated to version 1.0. This milestone update includes the following:


 Added more musical type sounds, bringing the built-in sound count to over 1,000!
 Fixed issues with the left stick not being responsive when initially opening the app.
 Fixed the Sound Edit and Settings screens being open at the same time.
 Fixed the Sound Edit Volume setting not saving properly.
 Updated some of the graphics.
 Fixed some tempo sync issues.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44970775/ae8a64e670ba0b0320b95e002ff4b2b5f8ca5f7e.png

The release date has been set as June 28 as well! Exciting times!

Thanks,

Larry
